request-prompt: Redesign the 'Product Reviews & Deals' module in the sidebar to be a wider, more visually rich grid format in the main content column to make it easier to browse outdoor gear recommendations.
goal: I frequently discover interesting things through sponsored content recommendations and product lists, and do not mind their presence.
jobs: I want to check the current weather conditions for my city or a specific zip code to plan my immediate outdoor activities.
I want to access detailed forecasts (such as hourly, 10-day, or monthly) to prepare for upcoming travel or events.
I want to view interactive weather radar maps to track rain, storms, or severe weather in real-time.
I want to read the latest weather news, top stories, and watch trending videos to stay informed about environmental events around the world.
I want to get seasonal health and safety tips, such as tick prevention or mosquito protection, to keep myself and my family safe.
I want to read reviews and recommendations for weather-related products like sunscreens and sun protective clothing to make smart purchase decisions.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer a strictly utility-driven interface that displays only raw data, charts, and maps, without any narrative news or lifestyle articles.
preference-pairs.b: I enjoy engaging with feature stories, background articles, and narrative videos related to the climate and environment.

preference-pairs.a: I use websites as quick, transactional tools to get immediate local information and exit as fast as possible.
preference-pairs.b: I like to casually browse and explore different thematic sections like travel, health, and lifestyle on a website.

preference-pairs.a: I am highly distracted by ads, promoted products, and sponsored content widgets, and actively try to filter them out of my view.
preference-pairs.b: I frequently discover interesting things through sponsored content recommendations and product lists, and do not mind their presence.

preference: I frequently discover interesting things through sponsored content recommendations and product lists, and do not mind their presence.
